about: Whether the Hub is doing work that an update would cut off. The rule is HubLifecycle.HasWork in native-shared/HubLifecycle.cs, which the installer applies before it stops the Hub and the shell applies BEFORE it exits; the page (ui/src/lib/updates.ts, hasActiveWork) applies the same rule to the part of the state it has, so that the button is disabled with its reason. Three implementations of one rule are held to ONE list of cases: scripts/tests/native-lifecycle/WorkTests.cs and CHATMCP-HUB/ui/tests/updates.test.mjs. `state` is what GET /api/state answers (only the parts the rule reads), `coding` what GET /api/studio/coding answers; `inState` is whether the rule finds work in the state, `inCoding` whether it finds work in the coding answer. The rule looks at the DIRECT properties of an object and descends into arrays only, and a state with no `agent` is work (fail closed).
